checks: Normal PCM import stays staged until audio, analysis and both JSON files are complete.
Interrupted document-provider reads and explicit import cancellation clean all staging.
Autosave commits matching state/metadata, preserves extensible version-1 provenance and retains one prior revision.
Restoring the previous saved revision swaps both files and can itself be undone.
Corrupted and missing current project files recover the matching last-good revision and record recovery time.
Durable journal rolls forward at marker-only, state-replaced and both-replaced interruption boundaries.
Uncommitted stages and legacy temporary writes are cleaned without replacing the approved state.
An actual filesystem failure replacing a staged file leaves current state and metadata unchanged.
Startup removes abandoned new and pre-1.4 imports without following symbolic links.
A separate JVM halts without cleanup; the next process recovers exact prepared ZIP, filename and partial destination.
Prepared export recovery retains only one ZIP, cleans interrupted work, rejects non-document destinations and clears retry state.
Explicit discard and truncated-export recovery release the prepared slot without touching unrelated files.
scope: Host JVM executing production Java storage classes; Android document provider, Activity callbacks, device lifecycle and vehicle playback require physical-device verification.
